Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 6, Verse 7

“For one who has conquered the self and is at peace, the supreme self is composed — in cold and heat, in pleasure and pain, in honour and dishonour alike.”

Three pairs of opposites, and the last is social rather than physical. Krishna knows reputation is what a warrior finds hardest to become genuinely indifferent to.
